capabilities: Suggest key completions learned from the vault or from optional JSON Schemas
Indent, move, sort and convert YAML nodes with structure-aware commands and hotkeys
Render standalone YAML files as a read-only report with headings, tables and clickable paths
Fold sections, navigate by dotted path, and show a status-bar breadcrumb
Open and edit standalone .yaml/.yml files in their own editor
disambiguation: Not a YAML formatter or style linter; it never reformats your text and reports parse errors only.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later; the status-bar breadcrumb is desktop-only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; render-view options are documented in RENDER.md and design details in SPEC.md and CLAUDE.md.
problem: Obsidian offers no structure-aware YAML editing, hides standalone .yaml/.yml files, and editing frontmatter or YAML code blocks means hand-managing indentation and key order.
summary: Structure-aware YAML editor with vault-learned completions, node-level editing commands, folding, and a rendered report view for YAML files.
